name: Rotterdam University of Applied Sciences
summary: Rotterdam hogeschool with three English bachelor's: International Business (3-year fast track for IB holders) and WdKA's Fine Art and Graphic Design.

ib.text: The IB Diploma meets the entry level (Dutch HAVO/VWO); no subject requirements. English: exempt if your schooling was entirely in English, otherwise IELTS 6.0, TOEFL iBT 80 or Cambridge 169.

apply.via: Studielink, then OSIRIS Application (WdKA: plus its form)

programmes.name: International Business
programmes.ib: IB Diploma holders can take the 3-year Fast Track (VWO-level entry) after an intake interview with the Fast Track coordinator.

programmes.name: Fine Art
programmes.ib: WdKA remote entrance exam (portfolio, home assignments, questionnaire, short video); limited places. 2027 round deadlines not yet published.

programmes.name: Graphic Design
programmes.ib: WdKA remote entrance exam (portfolio, home assignments, questionnaire, short video). 2027 round deadlines not yet published.

notes: WdKA's other majors (Illustration, Animation, Photography, Fashion and more) are officially Dutch-taught but admit international students, with teaching in English whenever they are in class.
International Business has a language track from year 1: Dutch for non-Dutch speakers, French, German, Spanish, Mandarin, Korean or Japanese.
Before you start, certified copies of your diploma and transcript must reach the university by post or in person by 31 August.
